Bash(cd /c/Repos/Pegasus-App && git add metro.config.js && git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
chore\(metro\): add metro.config.js to block test files from app bundle

Expo Router's require.context scans the entire app/ directory, causing
Metro to attempt bundling capture.test.tsx \(and any other *.test.tsx
files placed in app/\). Those test files import @testing-library/react-
native, which imports Node's 'console' module — a Node stdlib that does
not exist in the React Native runtime, producing a bundling failure.

Added metro.config.js with a resolver.blockList that excludes *.test.*
and *.spec.* files from the bundle. Jest is unaffected — it uses its
own module resolution and never consults metro.config.js.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)" && git push 2>&1)
